title: fix(plugin-security, spec): the master-detail write refusal names the master its user needs access to, in their language
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbSUQWB2j9eHYsRcrCiq1X1C)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：主从（controlled_by_parent）明细记录因缺少主记录编辑权限被拒（403）时，服务端现在附带 `userMessage`，用用户的语言点名主对象（如"合同"），新增、编辑、删除都生效。
- 为什么改：控制台只在拒绝带 `userMessage` 时显示具体原因，否则只显示"您无权保存此记录"；HotCRM 订单到收款的用户看不出缺的是合同上的权限。
- 风险与回滚：只新增 `userMessage`，`code`、状态码、`message`、`details` 和放行/拒绝结论都不变；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts` 步骤 2.8 的 catch 与 `masterGateDenialMessage`；`security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts` 的 `MASTER_DENIAL_NAMED_MASTER`（看不到主记录引用的用户不点名）；`operation-message.ts` 新增的四个文案键。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/controlled-by-parent-master-edit-user-message.test.ts`，预期 11/11 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #33524

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **spec, operation-message catalog:** four new keys in every locale the catalog carries (en, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES). `master_record_edit_denied` and `master_record_read_denied` take `{{master}}`, the master object's label. Their `_opaque` forms name no master. The catalog header gains the table row and the reason for the opaque forms. `BUILTIN_OPERATION_MESSAGES` is typed as a string-keyed record of string-keyed string records (`Record` of `string` to `Record` of `string` to `string`) in the built `dist/system/index.d.ts` (measured), and the new key names appear in no `.d.ts`/`.d.mts` file under `packages/spec/dist`. So the public type surface does not move.
- **plugin-security, write gate (`security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts`):** a weak map beside the existing leg and question maps records which master a refusal may name. `masterEditDenied` records the caller's object's master. The rewording for a caller who cannot read the master reference records none. `nullMasterOwnerDenied` (the owner rule of a row with no master) records nothing. `masterGateRefusalUserCopyOf(e)` reads the map. Nothing is added to the error itself.
- **plugin-security, authz middleware step 2.8 only:** a gate refusal gains `userMessage` through the existing `withUserMessage`. It is rendered by the existing `userFacingDenialMessage` on the caller's ladder (request locale, then workspace default, then en). The master is named by its translated label (`objects.MASTER.label` through the i18n service), else its declared label. With no label (or a label equal to the API name), the opaque form is used. `code`, status, `message` and `details` are unchanged. The same throw serves insert, update, delete, transfer, restore and purge.

## Tests

- `controlled-by-parent-master-edit-user-message.test.ts` (new, real `ObjectQL` over `SqlDriver`, 11 cases): create en; create zh-CN with a translated label; edit en + zh-CN; delete; a de-DE request falls back to the zh-CN workspace; ja-JP with no translation uses the declared label in the ja sentence; the read question on a `writeRequiresMasterRead` detail; a writer who cannot read the reference gets the opaque sentence; an unlabeled master gets the opaque sentence; CONTROL: the owner-rule refusal carries no `userMessage`; the REST data door's `mapDataError` relays it with 403 / `PERMISSION_DENIED`. Every case also asserts the unchanged code, status and diagnostic opening.
- `operation-message.test.ts` (spec): the four keys exist in every locale; named forms carry only `{{master}}` and opaque forms no placeholder; no grant or API vocabulary; edit differs from read and from sibling keys; en and zh-CN render; deployment override under `errors.KEY`.

## Acceptance notes

- Card acceptance 1 and 2 (create and edit, en and zh-CN) are pinned server-side here. The console half was pinned by `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.markedRefusal-33524.test.tsx` (PR #33576), which shows a refusal's `userMessage`. Acceptance 3 (no `userMessage` keeps the generic line) is that console pin. The server-side CONTROL is the owner-rule refusal.
- A refusal raised on a hop above the immediate master (a chain of two `controlled_by_parent` levels) names the immediate master. That is true of the refusal, because the caller cannot edit that master. On such a hop the sentence's edit/read question mirrors the diagnostic `message`'s question.
- The record field-access probe runs the same middleware, so a probe refusal now also carries the sentence. The probe reads the verdict, not the text.

## Verification

Head for the runs below: `cf6ef429`. The PR head adds one merge of `main` (30 commits, none touching the four changed files). The reruns on that head (closure build, `spec check:generated`, the plugin-security suite, the spec catalog test, both typechecks, rest's master-refusal wording test) are recorded in the os-dev-report on the card.

<details><summary>Ablations (each restored, `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards)</summary>

- Drop the `withUserMessage` attachment (`if (copy && false)`): 10 failed, 1 passed. Every naming case is red; the CONTROL stays green.
- Withheld refusal records the master (`{ master: rel?.master }`): 1 failed. `expected '您需要拥有这条记录所属合同的编辑权限…' to be '您需要拥有这条记录所属上级记录的编辑权限…'`.
- `nullMasterOwnerDenied` records a master: 1 failed (CONTROL). `expected true to be false` on `'userMessage' in e`.
- Fall back to the API name (`label === master` check removed): 1 failed. `expected 'You need edit access to the mue_vault…' to be 'You need edit access to the parent re…'`.

</details>

The 2 failing files are `published-subpath-console.pin` and `published-subpath-hook-body.pin`, which refuse in setup because `packages/cli/dist` was not built. That is NOT MEASURED, not red, and CI builds it. The cli integration layer is declared to CI. Dogfood is declared to CI's merge-queue gate (no `!` in the title).
